paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文针对深度神经网络难以训练的问题，提出了残差学习框架，让堆叠层学习相对于输入的残差映射而非无参照映射 [S1.p5]。作者在 ImageNet 上验证了极深残差网络易于优化，而对应的普通网络随深度增加训练误差反而升高 [S1.p7]。152 层残差网络是当时 ImageNet 上最深网络，复杂度仍低于 VGG，集成模型在测试集取得 3.57% top-5 错误率并赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军 [S1.p9]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层和 1000 层网络 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练变得更困难，出现了退化问题——更深的普通网络训练误差反而高于较浅网络 [S1.p7]。作者指出，深度对图像分类至关重要，但简单地堆叠更多层并不容易带来更好的网络 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance
Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
the counterpart “plain” nets (that simply stack layers) exhibit higher training error when the depth increases

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，显式地让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参照映射更容易；极端情况下若恒等映射最优，将残差推向零比用非线性层拟合恒等映射更容易 [S1.p5]。该重表述的动机来自退化现象：若新增层可构造为恒等映射，更深模型训练误差不应高于较浅模型，而退化问题表明求解器难以用多个非线性层逼近恒等映射 [S3.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
We hypothesize that it is easier to optimize the residual mapping than to optimize the original, unreferenced mapping
The degradation problem suggests that the solvers might have difficulties in approximating identity mappings by multiple nonlinear layers

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 分类数据集上评估了极深残差网络，其中 152 层残差网络是当时 ImageNet 上最深网络，复杂度仍低于 VGG [S1.p9]。ImageNet 实现中，图像短边随机采样于 [256,480] 进行尺度增强，随机裁剪 224×224 并减去逐像素均值，每个卷积后、激活前使用批归一化，用 SGD、mini-batch 256 从头训练，学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10，最多训练 60×10^4 次迭代 [S3.SS4.p1]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层和 1000 层网络 [abstract]，并在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测评估，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our 152-layer residual net is the deepest network ever presented on ImageNet, while still having lower complexity than VGG nets
We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256
The learning rate starts from 0.1 and is divided by 10 when the error plateaus
We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method

findings.text: 极深残差网络易于优化，而对应的普通网络随深度增加训练误差升高 [S1.p7]。残差网络能轻松从大幅增加的深度中获得精度提升，结果显著优于此前网络 [S1.p7]。在 ImageNet 测试集上，残差网络集成取得 3.57% top-5 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S1.p9]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 也克服了优化困难，随深度增加表现出精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]。在 COCO 目标检测上，ResNet-101 相比 VGG-16 在 mAP@[.5,.95] 上提升 6.0%，相对提升 28%，这一增益完全来自所学表示 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our extremely deep residual nets are easy to optimize, but the counterpart “plain” nets (that simply stack layers) exhibit higher training error when the depth increases
Our deep residual nets can easily enjoy accuracy gains from greatly increased depth
Our ensemble has 3.57% top-5 error on the ImageNet test set, and won the 1st place in the ILSVRC 2015 classification competition
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement

limitations.text: 作者承认，在 CIFAR-10 上 1202 层网络的测试结果差于 110 层网络，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是过拟合所致，1202 层网络对该小数据集可能过大 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者在本文中未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并指出结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。此外，作者指出深度普通网络优化困难的原因尚待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error
The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future
